title: Wavelength calculation
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be 2 m, derived from the correct formula λ = vT.

title: Source distance calculation
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be 16 cm, derived from the correct relationship S = 4A.

title: Period extraction
description: Important: The period T = 4 s must be correctly identified from the provided vibration graph.

title: Amplitude extraction
description: Important: The amplitude A = 4 cm must be correctly identified from the provided vibration graph.

title: Wave speed application
description: Important: The given wave speed v = 0.5 m/s must be correctly used in the wavelength formula.

title: Oscillator distance logic
description: Important: The reasoning must correctly relate the 4-second interval to one full period of simple harmonic motion.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The final answers should have correct and consistent units (meters for wavelength, centimeters for distance).

title: Confusing wave and source motion
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly calculates the wave's propagation distance instead of the source's vibrational travel distance.

title: Incorrect amplitude or period
description: Pitfall: Penalize misreading the graph, leading to wrong amplitude or period values.
